dataset_version: ForceBody 1.3.0 (benchmark inputs, labels, masks and splits identical to 1.2.0 / 1.2.1; 40 Hamner2013 trial keys renamed in 1.3.0)

decisions.D0prime: pose_source selects the pose set (pass0 | pass2). Default pass0. pass2 is allowed but its results carry leaky_input=True and are excluded from the official tables.
decisions.D21: Labels are normalized by mass_kg_dynamics; model inputs use mass_kg (recorded).
decisions.D24: Paper Table 3 (camera-ready): the ForceBody rows are the baselines retrained on dataset 1.2.1 over three seeds. The two AddB rows are taken from the reviewed build as a reference, not a matched comparison. They used dynamics-pass (pass 2) kinematics as input.
decisions.D25: Paper Tables 4, 5, 14 and 15 (camera-ready) are the baselines retrained on dataset 1.2.1 with the paper code, mean and standard deviation over three seeds, aggregation all_strata. BENCHMARK.md (Results) lists the same runs.
decisions.D26: Splits are split_addb (train/test, person level) and split_addb_val (validation persons drawn from the split_addb train persons).

pose_source.leaky_rule: pass2/dyn inputs: result json leaky_input=true, official_table_eligible=false

leakage.rule: allowlist: model inputs are only the benchmark inputs below (tasks.*.inputs), all derived from the pass-0 pose set, betas and the recorded mass / height (forcebody_io.ALLOWED_INPUT_FIELDS for the underlying fields). LEAKY_INPUT_FIELDS is a denylist safety net
leakage.enforcement: build_bench_cache_v12.check_inputs raises ValueError for any input on the denylist and for any input that is not a benchmark input (allowlist)

values.train: split_addb == train and not a validation person
values.val: split_addb_val == val (subset of the split_addb train persons)

splits.protocol: Select checkpoints and hyperparameters on val only. Score test once.

G_mps2.source: forces_lib.py:70 and qc_v12.py:45 of the v1.2 build (G = 9.81, the constant of build_v11.py and the v1.1 QC)

inputs.notes: poses [T,46] of the chosen pose source; trans_vel [T,3] = numpy.gradient(trans, 1/fps_true_grid) within the trial (m/s); betas [10] per person; mass_kg = recorded mass (D21); height_m recorded. Optional q/qd/qdd = q_kin/qd_kin/qdd_kin for pass0 (q_gt family for pass2, i.e. leaky). Models may derive further features (pose velocity etc.) from these inputs within a trial.

label.frame: addb_lab (OpenSim Rajagopal DOF sign conventions, dof_names_opensim)
label.scored_dofs: direct_dof_mask (20 DOFs: hip x3, knee, ankle, mtp per side; elbow, radioulnar, wrist x2 per side)

T-tau.mask: eval_tau_frame_ok AND eval_torque_trial_ok (eval_tau_frame_ok = tau_frame_ok AND kin_frame_ok; eval_torque_trial_ok excludes force-unusable, single-channel, duplicate / Han2023 trimmed-copy, static / transition / pause, root-residual > 0.1 BW and qc_mass_dyn_vs_grf_flag trials)
T-tau.prediction_format: npz, one key per trial_uid, float array [T,37] in N m/kg (columns in dof_names order; only scored DOFs are read; must be finite on scored frames)

T-GRF.description: Per-frame ground reaction force of each foot from motion.

label.frame: skel_world (flip_xz of addb_lab), y up, gravity -y
label.contacts: index 0 = right foot (calcn_r), 1 = left foot (calcn_l). The Falisse2017 chair channel (contact 2, pelvis) is not a target.

T-GRF.grm_definition: The ground reaction moment (GRM) in ForceBody is contact_torque (addb_lab) / contact_torque_aligned (skel_world): the free moment per contact, in N m, acting at the centre of pressure (cop / cop_aligned_foot). The resultant moment of a foot about a point p is (cop - p) x grf + contact_torque. GRM and CoP are not scored in T-GRF v1.2 (Carter2023 running free moments are about five times Hamner2013). Paper Table 3 GRF is the sum over the two feet of the 3D error norm in N/kg (grf_paper_metric in code/baselines/aggregate.py). The secondary group 'sum_feet' scores the two-foot total force, a different quantity.
T-GRF.mask: eval_grf_frame_ok AND eval_grf_trial_ok (eval_grf_frame_ok = grf_frame_ok AND kin_frame_ok; eval_grf_trial_ok excludes force-unusable, single-channel, duplicate / Han2023 trimmed-copy, static / transition / pause and qc_mass_dyn_vs_grf_flag trials). grf_valid_mask covers measured frames only; on Carter2023 running it excludes the flight frames, so T-GRF on running is scored on stance frames

sum_feet.idx: derived: right + left per component (3 channels)
sum_feet.note: two-foot total force (right + left per component)

T-GRF.prediction_format: npz, one key per trial_uid, float array [T,2,3] in BW (skel_world, right foot first; must be finite on scored frames)

per_channel.rmse: sqrt(mean over scored frames of (pred - label)^2), in label units (per-frame, per-kg or BW)
per_channel.mae: mean over scored frames of |pred - label|
per_channel.pcc: Pearson r over the pooled scored frames of the channel. 0 when the prediction variance is 0 and the label variance is not (a constant prediction scores 0); undefined (NaN, left out of the group mean, counted) only when the label variance is 0

pcc_zero_variance.rule: a variance counts as 0 when sum((x - mean)^2) <= rel_tol * sum(x^2) (float64 cancellation of a constant series)

metrics.group_value: mean over the channels of the group (as in paper Table 4)

aggregations.pooled: all scored frames of the healthy stratum pooled (headline)
aggregations.study_macro: per-study pooled metric, then the unweighted mean over studies (healthy stratum)
aggregations.per_activity: pooled within each activity_recovered class (healthy stratum)
aggregations.pathological: eval_stratum == pathological (Fregly2012 TKA, Li2021 stroke; D18): pooled and per study, reported separately, never mixed into the headline
aggregations.all_strata: healthy + pathological pooled, for reference only

bootstrap.unit: person (resample persons with replacement; all scored frames of a drawn person enter)
bootstrap.source: OURS (user decision U4, 2026-09-30): 1000 person-level resamples, percentile interval, seed 0. No citation is claimed for these values.

paper_style_reference.definition: per DOF: RMSE and MAE of N m errors over GRF-valid frames divided by the mean body mass of those frames, PCC per DOF, averaged over the DOF group. Used only to show that the scorer reproduces the submitted-paper numbers on the submitted-paper inputs; not the v1.2 metric.
paper_style_reference.gate: max abs difference <= 1e-6 on the paper test cache and the verify_run checkpoints

results_json.official_table_eligible: pose_source in (pass0, kin) AND split == test AND spec_version matches

paper_numbers: The camera-ready paper Tables 3 (ForceBody rows), 4, 5, 14 and 15 report the baselines retrained on dataset 1.2.1 (benchmark data identical in 1.3.0) as the mean and standard deviation over three seeds, aggregation all_strata, checkpoints selected on the 12 validation persons, the 19 test persons scored once. The two AddB rows of Table 3 (D24) come from the reviewed build and used AddB dynamics-pass (pass 2) kinematics as input (force-label leakage). The submitted version of the paper used ForceBody 1.0.0 (reviewed build) with v1 torque labels, the P80 subset, validation set == test set and one seed. Those numbers are not v1.2 benchmark numbers.
